question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

IRKSOME
solution:
The correct answer is "**Annoying**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Irksome **is an adjective used to describe something that is annoying, bothersome, or causing irritation. It can be used to refer to a person, situation, or thing that is causing discomfort or frustration. 

 
 
• ***For example,** "The constant ringing of my phone was irksome and made it hard for me to focus on my work."*
 
 

**Let's see the meanings of the given words**__

 
• **Helpful** means providing aid or assistance. 

 
 
• ***For example,** "The customer service representative was very **helpful** in resolving my issue."*
 
 
 
• **Interesting** means captivating or holding one's attention. 
 
 
• ***For example,** "The history lecture was **interesting** as it covered a topic that I had never heard of before."*
 
 
 
• **Tireless** means having or showing great energy, enthusiasm, or persistence. 
 
 
• ***For example, **"The athlete was **tireless** in her training and always pushed herself to improve."*
 
 
 
• **Annoying** means causing irritation or frustration. 
 
 
• ***For example,** "The constant chatter of my co-worker was **annoying** and made it hard for me to focus on my work."*
 
 

**According to the meanings of the given words,** *the correct answer is **Option 4, i.e., Annoying.***
